name: mp-repair-cross-resolution
title: A repair between a 1920x1080 host and a 960x540 client: the client draws the backdrops at its own scale after it

checklist.what: Play advances before the host's one-shot RNG perturbation at tick 240.
checklist.assert: The probe observes Running play from tick 60 through tick 210 before injection.

checklist.what: The automatic repair displays Restoring the shared match state after the deliberately injected divergence; its toast names the repair's cause (Match repair started: whose game fell out of step, at which frame) and never repeats the screen's line.
checklist.assert: Saved ResyncOverlay frames and native divergence/host-snapshot reload lines; no repair button is pressed.
log_regex: \[net-match\] resync: reloading from the host snapshot

checklist.what: The healed match resumes and the visible toast names the frame restored from the host snapshot.
checklist.assert: The native relaunch log and the visible Match resynced toast agree that repair completed.
log_regex: \[net-match\] resync: match relaunched from the snapshot

checklist.what: Both peers continue playing through tick 900 after the automatic repair.
checklist.assert: The engine's own records after the completion: the relaunch line, the relaunched round's first frame, every tick committed from it through tick 900 in the trace, actors moving across them and alive in the match report.

resumed_play.relaunch: \[net-match\] resync: match relaunched from the snapshot
